import requests

def check_isoforms(acc):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json"
    data = requests.get(url).json()
    comments = data.get("comments", [])
    for c in comments:
        if c.get("commentType") == "ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS":
            print(acc, "Isoforms:")
            for iso in c.get("isoforms", []):
                print(" ", iso.get("name"), iso.get("isoformIds"), iso.get("isoformSequenceStatus"))

check_isoforms("Q9BZG8")
check_isoforms("Q5TDH0")
